title: Trackers

image.alt: An echo shard, the StatTrak Creator

summary: **Trackers** add a live counter to a weapon, tool or fishing rod: kills, mob kills, blocks broken or fish caught. Win them from crates.

blocks.p: Trackers come from [crates](/wiki/smp/crates/). None of them can be crafted.

ul: {{icon:echo_shard}} StatTrak Creator: player kills with a weapon.
{{icon:popped_chorus_fruit}} MobTrak Creator: mob kills with a weapon.
{{icon:amethyst_cluster}} BlockTrak Creator: blocks broken with a tool.
{{icon:purple_dye}} FishTrak Creator: fish caught with a fishing rod.

blocks.p: Drag the Creator on top of the item in your inventory to apply it. FishTrak only goes on a fishing rod. The item then shows a counter line in its lore, such as StatTrak Kills or BlockTrak Blocks Broken, and it counts up as you use it.

ul: A shattered Chromatic, Halloween or Living Prism item keeps its StatTrak count.

{{icon:chest}} The Living Prism Crate can also give a Sell Chest, an auto-sell chest that sells what is inside on a timer and pays you, even while you are offline. See [Spawners and Hoppers](/wiki/smp/spawners-and-hoppers/).
